entries.zh: 杂乱无章；荒诞无稽（语无伦次）
entries.en: absurd, nonsensical; spoken in a jumbled, higgledy-piggledy manner
entries.notes: 词头首汉字污损待考（插/抖）且原稿声调 T99 难辨，仅依 chap-chap（杂杂）与 disparatado 暂拟。

entries.zh: （教法上的）豁免特许；准许自行办理
entries.en: to grant a dispensation (exemption from the rule) and license; permission to act on one's own
entries.notes: 西语栏 missa/minis 与汉字栏 獎/辦 两处待考，依 Dispensar（教规豁免）与 licencia（许可）暂拟。

entries.en: good build and stature; sound condition
entries.notes: 单字'丈'与词头对应不明，取 17 世纪 disposición 常义（体格身量）暂拟。

entries.en: to size up the times and circumstances; look well to it and act accordingly
to expound, set out in full detail
entries.notes: M 栏混入 nticar/comverzar/apto 等难解串且 R 栏 zu-chien 与敷陈官话音不合，释义依敷陈本义暂拟。

entries.zh: 草创；起稿、拟办所当做之事
entries.en: to draft, sketch out; to plan what is to be done
to pack up one's luggage, get things ready to carry
settled, rightly done; well, just so
entries.notes: 单字'着'对应稍宽，取闽语 tio（着＝妥/对）义暂拟。

entries.en: to dispute and argue; discuss it out by reasoning

entries.notes: 西语栏[空]，释义依汉字'議論'与 M/R 两栏拟定。

entries.zh: 辩难；诘难驳辩（如争讼般辩驳）
entries.en: to challenge and refute in argument, as in pleading a case

entries.zh: 辩开；辩而有分歧、意见相左
entries.en: to dispute and differ, draw apart somewhat in argument
entries.notes: '辯開'搭配少见且 R 栏 cay（开）与 M 栏 uy 不一致，释义依 apartarse algo 暂拟。

entries.en: far, distant; a long way apart
entries.notes: M 栏声调 T99 污损难辨，遠＝far 语义虽明仍按纪律降级。

entries.en: to leave, part from; to be distant from
entries.notes: M 栏两处声调 T99 污损且 guyax/torse 等音串难解，依'离'与 Li-huy（离远）暂拟。
